data.description:
Emerson T&M Group(NI) Application Engineers ensure customer success at strategic accounts by demonstrating strong technical aptitude and professional engineering skills. They provide innovative solutions, deliver projects, and become trusted technical partners for customers.
This role requires deep semiconductor industry knowledge, strong problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to work directly with customers to address complex engineering challenges.
We are seeking an experienced engineer with a strong background in mixed-signal semiconductor testing and validation. Experience in optical communication, silicon photonics, optical modules, or high-speed interface applications is highly preferred.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Ensure Account and Project Success
1. Partner with Sales to win opportunities by achieving key support objectives for assigned accounts and projects, including project delivery, issue resolution, and customer proficiency development.
2. Identify technical and project risks ahead of deployment and drive execution plans to meet customer timelines.
3. Demonstrate troubleshooting expertise to resolve customer issues and provide clear updates on progress, findings, and next actions.
4. Manage technical activities throughout project deployment, validation, production ramp, and sustaining phases.
5. Deliver technical solutions that meet customer requirements using NI systems, software, and services.

Provide Semiconductor Automated Test Technical Leadership
1. Develop, debug, and validate test programs using NI software and hardware platforms to solve customer test challenges in mixed-signal semiconductor applications.
2. Support characterization, validation, and production deployment activities for analog and mixed-signal devices.
3. Design and integrate test systems using PXI instrumentation, including SMU, digitizer, digital I/O, oscilloscope, switching, and timing modules.
4. Design sophisticated analog and digital test interfaces to implement signal conditioning, switching, filtering, signal conversion, and measurement functions.
5. Support measurement correlation, test optimization, and production debug activities.
6. Provide technical consultation on mixed-signal test methodologies and semiconductor test architectures.
7. Develop competitive analyses and technology comparisons based on semiconductor test and measurement industry knowledge.

Support Optical Communication Applications
1. Maintain awareness of optical communication industry trends, emerging technologies, and related testing challenges.
2. Understand test requirements for optical modules, transceivers, silicon photonics, optical interconnects, and related applications.
3. Develop automated validation and production test solutions for electrical and optical measurements.
4. Support integration of optical instruments and high-speed measurement equipment into automated test systems.

Contribute to Customer Success
1. Build strong technical relationships with customer engineering teams.
2. Serve as a trusted technical resource for customers and account teams.
3. Represent the voice of the customer by communicating application requirements and market needs to internal stakeholders.
4. Support development of reusable architectures, application examples, and technical best practices.
5. Help bridge customer requirements with NI semiconductor solutions and offerings.

Who You Are:

You build strong partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You analyze complex situations, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions to technical challenges. You communicate clearly and effectively with diverse audiences while tailoring technical information to customer needs. You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and consistently deliver high-quality results that support customer success and business objectives.

data.description:
我們正在尋找優秀的夥伴加入我們的團隊，
為我們全球金融投資合作夥伴提供專業的系統後台監控與維護服務！
如果你對Fintech領域相關技術充滿熱忱，這將是你發展職涯的絕佳機會！

工作內容：
1. 負責產品後台相關的系統參數維護與資料橋接處理
2. 與不同班別的團隊成員交接工作細項，確保資訊完整傳遞
3. 協助擔任專案的項目管理，需要有責任心
4. 學習MT4/MT5系統架構、執行後台程序，定時定期匯報給主管

希望你具備以下條件：
1. 熟悉金融市場運作，有投資經驗者尤佳
2. 熱愛學習，能夠快速吸收新知，且擅長筆記與整理重點
3. 高度自律具備自我管理能力，能有效規劃與安排自己的工作
4. 善於溝通協作，能與團隊成員順利交接工作，確保資訊無縫銜接
5. 擅長分析與筆記整理，能將複雜資訊轉換成關鍵重點
6. 擅長Office軟體，能對資料進行彙整及有效篩選

我們提供：
1. 具競爭力的薪資與獎金制度
　－基本薪資 41,000元起，具備MT4/MT5後台維護經驗者，基本薪資 50,000元起
　－培訓初期 09:30-18:00，進入做中學的實務工作時，開始加入排班排休班表
　－日(晨)班 06:00-14:30 (05:00-13:30) / 中班 11:00-19:30 / 晚班 15:00-23:30 
　－每月依據工作表現計算工作獎金，讓你的努力都能有實質的獎勵
2. 從零到有的專業培訓與學習資源，助你提升後台架構及產業專業技能
3. 固定班別讓您工作與生活平衡更容易
4. 優質的工作環境與團隊氛圍
5. 內部發展機會與職涯成長空間
6. 開放且友善的工作環境

如果你符合以上條件，並希望有個接觸市場一線資訊的領域發展，請立即投遞履歷！

*我們年終已經換成每個月的工作獎金，你不需要等一年一度的收入，透過每個月額外實拿獎金的評鑑制度，年薪一樣很迷人! 期待你的加入，共同成長！

*本專案薪資以美金(USD)簽約，保障1280元起，每月換算台幣薪資將依匯率浮動，約41,000元起，實際入職基本薪資依面試表現評核，並於錄取通知時確認。

*本職缺於台北入職後，培訓期將於台中或台北培訓，通過試用期後，工作期間表現優異者，如遇海外團隊有人力缺口時，有機會優先安排到英國倫敦、日本大阪或其他地區的工作團隊就職；如入職海外公司時，薪資將依當地規定重新約定敘薪，歡迎對國際技術交流感興趣的候選人應徵諮詢。
